# A chain of custom levels (851-3135): loaded from the menu, each leading to the next, to the custom end room.
# Picks FIRST with the mouse (230: oMenuSel) and loads it with Enter (240). FIRST (3 lives, 2 bombs, 1 rope; no
# exit names and one sign message, WELCOME) is walked through, over a gold bar, to its exit (260-296). The transition takes
# four attack presses (360-400) and goes back to rLoadLevel, which loads FIRST's next level, SECOND, keeping
# the lives, bombs and ropes (scrLoadLevel(-1)). SECOND has two entrances and two exits named in scan order:
# the player starts at the entrance whose name is the level just left (FIRST), not the nearest one, and the
# first exit (420-461) leads to THIRD instead of SECOND's next level, NOWHERE. THIRD has no next level, so
# after its exit (600-641) and transition (700-760) scrLoadLevel finds no levels/.lvl and goes to rEndCustom.
# oEndCustom counts the money (an Enter while it does, 820, does nothing), adds 1.1's 50000 bonus, and two
# Enters (1010, 1040) fade it out to rHighscores. The window is 3x (screenScale 3).
